name: Impulse Ventures
reason: Tomek-backed VC fund with real past investments (Itera/Taikun 2022), but no investment dated in the 24-month window (on or after 2024-10-29) was found in any fetched source; latest evidence is an exit in Aug 2025.

name: Air Ventures
reason: Registered Prague VC entity, but no investment dated in the 24-month window was found; the only deal seen is an aggregator snippet from Dec 2023 and the firm's own website was unreachable.

name: Koopeo Ventures
reason: Brno-registered early-stage fund whose only independently documented deal is Precismo (2020); no investment dated in the 24-month window was found and its own website shows no dates.

name: STARTGUIDE VC
reason: Posledna nezavisle doložená investicia (Carebot seed, marec 2024) je mimo 24-mesacneho okna (od 2024-10-29); v okne nie je ziadna nezavisle doloz. investicia.

name: Pale Fire Capital
reason: Zmiesana investicna skupina (verejne akcie + sukromne podiely, sama sa oznacuje ako private equity, nie VC); v okne prevladaju nakupy podielov v kotovanych spolocnostiach (Edenred, Coursera, TUI...), nove sukromne transakcie takmer ziadne. Hranicny pripad - skor PE mimo vzorky VC.

name: RockawayX
reason: Kryptoinfrastrukturna/liquidity divizia skupiny Rockaway (predaj Solmate dohodnuty dec 2025, rozvazany mar 2026); portfolio je prevazne tokenove/protokolove a nepodarilo sa najst ziadnu datovanu nezavislu kapitalovu investiciu v okne. Konzervativne vyradene.

name: Zero Gravity Capital
reason: Slovensky fond (Bratislava; CzechCrunch: 'slovenské fondy Zero Gravity Capital'), nie sidlo v CR - mimo vzorky.

name: SFG Holding
reason: Holding Michala Dedka (financie, nehnutelnosti, startupy): historicke startup investicie (ETW, NutritionPro, Buildiro, Edhance) bez datumov v okne; ziadna nezavisle doložená investicia v okne (36 mes. od 2023-10-29).

name: RSJ Investments
reason: Multi-strategy group (real estate, PE, VC); its VC activity (RSJ Tech IV) is described by the manager itself as a fund of funds, direct co-investments (Pigment, Moonpay, Manta) are undated and no independent dated direct deal in the 24-month window was found.

name: Thein
reason: Real investor, wrong type for VC sample: PE (LBO/growth capital in industry and IT/cybersecurity buyouts, e.g. Your System Jun 2024). X11 used as sample-scope code (PE is out of the VC sample, not a quality exclusion).

name: KB SmartSolutions
reason: Bank-owned strategic fintech vehicle; only in-window events found are buying out remaining minority holders of already-controlled Upvest (Aug 2025) and selling its Roger stake (Jan 2025); a Jul 2025 Finbricks round appears only on an aggregator. No verified new minority VC investment in the window - conservative exclude.

name: mAccelerator.vc (mBank)
reason: Unverifiable and apparently inactive: only a CzechStartups portal description exists; the fund's own domain now shows a parked Polish-hosting placeholder, no portfolio or deal found; parent mBank S.A. operates in Czechia only via a branch, so HQ may also be outside CZ (X11 not confirmed).

name: Genesis Capital
reason: Real investor, wrong type for VC sample: PE manager (buyouts, EUR 10-35m equity tickets; Slevomat majority acquisition Nov 2025). X11 used as sample-scope code.

name: ARX Equity Partners
reason: Real investor, wrong type for VC sample: growth-oriented buyout PE firm (majority stakes, EUR 5-50m transactions). X11 used as sample-scope code.

name: EVERITA Capital
reason: Real investor, wrong type for VC sample: lower-mid-market PE growth capital; the firm states it does not finance seed, start-up or venture projects. X11 used as sample-scope code.

name: Orbit Capital (OGD Advisory)
reason: Primarily venture/growth debt (Orbit Growth Debt II is an EIF private-credit fund; venture debt out of scope in v1). Its smaller Growth Equity fund made four equity investments in total; the latest equity deal found (CloudTalk, Jan 2024) predates the activity window.

name: Stratum Partners
reason: Real investor, wrong type for VC sample: Czech/Slovak growth-equity and buyout PE (EUR 2-6m tickets; majority stakes e.g. Poptávej.cz Dec 2025). X11 used as sample-scope code.

name: Enterprise Investors
reason: Real investor, wrong type for VC sample (buyout/expansion PE) and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, outside the sample country.

name: Mid Europa Partners
reason: Real investor, wrong type for VC sample (large-cap buyout PE, EUR 50-300m equity cheques) and headquartered in London, outside the sample country.

name: Fond rizikového kapitálu, s.r.o.
reason: Historický fond z roku 1995 (podľa médií 'za dobu své existence' 11 investícií, opisovaný v minulom čase); žiadna doložená investícia v okne aktivity a subjekt sa nepodarilo nájsť v ARES, takže ani jeho existenciu nevieme overiť. Zároveň ide o PE, nie VC.

name: HitHit
reason: Odmeňový crowdfunding: platforma prepája tvorcov s podporovateľmi, ktorí dostávajú odmeny, nie podiely; HitHit sám nič neinvestuje.

name: Fundlift
reason: Investičná crowdfundingová platforma: investujú jej používatelia do emitentov (konvertibilné certifikáty, minibondy), Fundlift sám nie je investor.

name: Investown
reason: Platforma, cez ktorú investujú používatelia (investičné úvery); predmetom sú úvery zabezpečené nehnuteľnosťami, nie podiely v neburzových firmách.

name: Garage Angels
reason: Neformálna skupina jednotlivých anjelov; každý člen investuje vlastné peniaze, Garage Angels ako subjekt kapitál nemá ani nerozhoduje (ani vlastný fond/syndikát nie je doložený). Najbližší kód je X2 (investujú členovia, nie subjekt); hraničný prípad, rozhodnuté konzervatívne.

name: Czech Private Equity and Venture Capital Association (CVCA)
reason: Profesijná asociácia PE/VC fondov (členovia: fondy, pridružení: právnici, poradcovia, banky); sama nespravuje ani neinvestuje kapitál. Pravidlá X1-X11 nemajú presný kód pre asociáciu, použitý X1 (nespĺňa test Kapitál; zastupuje a sprostredkúva, neinvestuje).

name: JŠK (law firm)
reason: Advokátska kancelária; poradca pri transakciách (ocenená v kategórii pre poradcov na CVCA & SLOVCA Awards), neinvestuje vlastný kapitál.

name: CzechInvest
reason: Štátna agentúra na podporu podnikania a investícií: investičné stimuly, vízová podpora, inkubácia a dátová podpora ekosystému; nedohľadal som žiadnu priamu kapitálovú investíciu do firiem. Program bez equity (X3).

name: European Investment Fund (EIF)
reason: Fond fondov: investuje do fondov spravovaných tretími stranami (ich zoznam 'equity fund partners' k 30. 9. 2026), nie priamo do startupov v ČR; sídlo v Luxembursku (mimo krajiny vzorky).

name: EBRD (EBRD Venture Capital)
reason: Mnohostranná banka so sídlom v Londýne (mimo krajiny vzorky). EBRD Venture Capital síce figuruje ako investor českej firmy Manta (spolu s Credo Ventures a Senovo), ale pre pilotnú vzorku 'VC so sídlom v ČR' vypadáva; v celej DB by si zasluhovala samostatné posúdenie.

name: Národní rozvojová banka (NRB)
reason: Štátna rozvojová banka: jej nástroje sú úvery a záruky (X5). Kapitálové aktivity vykonáva cez dcéru National Development Investment, a.s. a cez fond fondov CEFoF, ktorý investuje do VC/PE fondov, nie priamo do startupov (X6).

name: Seed Fund (Český rozvojový uzavřený investiční fond)
reason: Vládny koinvestičný nástroj z rokov 2011-2013; zdroje z roku 2013 uvádzajú, že fond ešte neinvestoval, a žiadny novší zdroj neukazuje investície v okne aktivity. Subjekt som nenašiel v ARES, existenciu ani aktivitu preto nevieme nezávisle overiť.
